env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd probe
! logos lint ./direct
stderr 'direct.go:16:[0-9]+: \[correctness::withlock_leak\]'
! logos lint ./capture
stderr 'capture.go:16:[0-9]+: \[correctness::withlock_leak\]'
logos lint ./copy
! stderr .

-- probe/go.mod --
module example.com/lockgoroutine

go 1.27
-- probe/direct/direct.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package direct

import "logos/sync"

type Box struct { N int }
func use(b *Box) { b.N++ }
func useValue(n int) {}

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[Box]
	lock.WithLock(func(b *Box) {
		go use(b)
	})
}
-- probe/capture/capture.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package capture

import "logos/sync"

type Box struct { N int }
func use(b *Box) { b.N++ }
func useValue(n int) {}

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[Box]
	lock.WithLock(func(b *Box) {
		go func() { use(b) }()
	})
}
-- probe/copy/copy.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package copy

import "logos/sync"

type Box struct { N int }
func use(b *Box) { b.N++ }
func useValue(n int) {}

func Use() {
	var lock sync.Locked[Box]
	lock.WithLock(func(b *Box) {
		go useValue(b.N)
	})
}
